<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Player N/c-center at top-left panel (r22,c22). Comet N/W-center at r31,c43.
# Try moving player to left hole (r33-35,c12-14) to test if that completes level.
# Move LEFT 3x then DOWN 4x
seq = ['LEFT']*3 + ['DOWN']*4
for a in seq:
    action([a])
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']<=10 and n['id']==2:
            b=n['boundary']; rr=[p[0] for p in b]; cc=[p[1] for p in b]
            print(a,"player r",min(rr),'-',max(rr),'c',min(cc),'-',max(cc))
            break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("LEVEL DONE!"); break
print("step",current_frame.step,"level",current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
